2026-09-03.english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇：The Ant and the Grasshopper In a sunny meadow, a diligent ant toiled each day, storing grain for the coming winter. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger, while the ant enjoyed a warm, full burrow. The grasshopper learned that foresight and hard work are essential for survival. This ancient fable reminds us: today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 中文翻译：在一个阳光明媚的草地上，一只勤奋的蚂蚁每天辛劳，为即将到来的冬天储存粮食。一只无忧无虑的蚱蜢唱歌并嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。当雪覆盖田野时，蚱蜢因饥饿而颤抖，而蚂蚁享受着温暖而充实的洞穴。蚱蜢明白了远见和勤奋是生存的关键。这个古老的寓言提醒我们：今天的准备是明天的安全。 重点词汇：diligent (勤奋的), toil (辛劳), store (储存), mock (嘲笑), shiver (颤抖), foresight (远见), essential (必要的), fable (寓言), preparation (准备), security (安全)
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 勤奋的蚂蚁每天储存粮食。2. 蚱蜢嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。3. 远见和勤奋是生存的关键。 英译中：1. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. 2. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger. 3. Today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 填空：1. The ant ______ grain for the coming winter. (store的适当形式) 2. The grasshopper learned that ______ and hard work are essential. (根据文章填词)

📖 30天趣味记忆·第2篇
第2篇：The Power of Persistence 英文原文： In the journey of life, setbacks are inevitable. However, those who achieve remarkable success often share a common trait: persistence. When faced with obstacles, they do not retreat but instead adjust their strategies and forge ahead. As the saying goes, 'The secret of success is constancy to purpose.' Every failure teaches a valuable lesson, and every effort accumulates strength. Remember, the bamboo grows slowly at first, but once its roots are deep, it shoots up rapidly. So, keep striving, for your breakthrough may be just around the corner. 中文翻译： 在人生旅途中，挫折不可避免。然而，那些取得显著成功的人往往有一个共同特质：坚持。面对障碍时，他们不退缩，而是调整策略，继续前进。正如谚语所说：“成功的秘诀在于对目标的恒心。”每一次失败都教会我们宝贵的经验，每一分努力都在积累力量。记住，竹子起初生长缓慢，但一旦根系扎深，便会迅速拔高。所以，继续努力吧，你的突破可能就在眼前。 重点词汇：persistence (坚持), setback (挫折), inevitable (不可避免的), trait (特质), obstacle (障碍), retreat (退却), strategy (策略), forge (奋力前进), constancy (恒心), accumulate (积累), breakthrough (突破).
✅ 每日自测
1. 中译英：a) 挫折是不可避免的。 b) 他调整策略并继续前进。 c) 成功的关键在于坚持。 2. 英译中：a) The secret of success is constancy to purpose. b) Every failure teaches a valuable lesson. c) Your breakthrough may be just around the corner. 3. 句子填空：a) When faced with ______, they do not retreat. (提示：障碍) b) Every effort ______ strength. (提示：积累)
